subject: maths
question: Mohan purchases a table at an MRP of Rs. 800, at a discount of 10%. If he sells it at Rs. 900, then the profit percentage is:
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) = Rs.800

Discount = 10%

Selling price (S.P) = Rs.900

**Formula used:**

S.P = M.P × (100 - D)%

Profit (P) = S.P - C.P

Profit% = (P × 100)/C.P

**Calculation:**

Mohan C.P = 800 × (100 - 10)%

⇒ 800 × 90% = Rs.720

Mohan S.P = 900

Profit = S.P - C.P

⇒ (900 - 720) = Rs.180

Profit% = (P × 100)/C.P

⇒ (180 × 100)/720

⇒ (1 × 100)/4 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**
